S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.notes: Agent selects wrong flight/item/variant when multiple structured records exist; fails to compare specs across options (flight numbers, item IDs, cabin classes)

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.notes: Most common failure: incorrect arguments to tool calls (wrong reservation_id, wrong item_ids, wrong payment_method_id, wrong flight number). Agent identifies what to do but passes incorrect IDs or parameters.

S3.label: Multi-step completion
S3.notes: Agent completes first action but fails to execute all required steps. Especially fails when tasks require: cancel+rebook, multi-reservation batch operations, address+item change together.

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.notes: Agent violates policy boundaries: modifies origin/destination (policy prohibits), processes cross-payment refunds (policy prohibits), gives compensation without proper triggers, fails to recognize when task is impossible and transfer is needed.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.notes: Wrong certificate amounts, wrong refund calculations, incorrect price differences, wrong totals communicated. Arithmetic errors in computing savings or net charges.

S6.label: Record discovery
S6.notes: Agent retrieves wrong record or misses required records: looks up wrong order ID, doesn't find all reservations belonging to user, picks incorrect flight number, fails to enumerate all qualifying records.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.notes: Agent completes the DB action but fails to communicate specific numeric values required (refund totals, certificate balances, price differences, item counts). Communicate checks fail.

S8.label: Conditional/state reasoning
S8.notes: Agent fails to apply conditional logic: misses 'if no direct flight then...' branches, can't detect when policy exception applies, gets trapped by social engineering (flattery loop), doesn't handle 'if possible else' branching.

S9.label: Language fluency
S9.notes: Agent gets drawn into irrelevant creative/emotional conversation and completely fails to execute the actual customer request (exchange).

S12.label: Hallucination of tools
S12.notes: R27: Agent invents a new order booking instead of exchange. R76: too_many_errors suggests repeated invalid tool calls.

S13.label: Format compliance
S13.notes: Task is a poem-guessing request entirely outside service scope; agent fails to redirect and runs max_steps or answers off-topic.

S14.label: Context window mgmt
S14.notes: All max_steps failures where agent loops or stalls — typically repeating lookup steps, re-confirming already-confirmed items, or getting stuck in confirmation loops over long conversation histories.
